verdict: Post-1945 result holds through 2025: the expected-return share is 0.89 (paper sample 0.91) and the dividend-growth share is 0.12 (paper sample 0.10). The return-predictability t-statistic is 1.69 (paper sample 2.10), so returns are no longer significantly predictable at the 5% level on their own. Strips still have a smaller expected-return share than the market (0.77 vs 0.96; paper 0.56 vs 0.96).
